title: A trial of a new test file, a new e2e case and a source edit runs fewer than 60 test files
description: In a clone of this repository, a commit adds one test file and one e2e case and edits one source file. The selection the merge writer's trial runs (scripts/ci-tests.mjs affected with the base tip) leaves out the tests that only list tests/ or e2e/cases/, so it holds the new test and fewer than 60 test files; the batch gate, selecting with no base, still runs the listing tests.

steps.name: Select the trial's tests for a new test file, a new e2e case and a source edit
